problem_summary.summary: Reverse the nodes at 1-indexed positions left through right, leaving the rest of the singly linked list in place.
problem_summary.input_output: Inputs: non-null ListNode head and positions left/right. Return the resulting ListNode head. The judge supplies ListNode { int val; ListNode next; }.

brute_force.explanation: Store references to all nodes in an array, reverse the selected array segment, then reconnect their next links in array order.
brute_force.correctness_idea: The selected references are reordered into exactly the reverse positional order; links outside the segment retain their original sequence when the entire reference array is reconnected.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(n) — collect, reverse the selected reference range, and reconnect the list.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(n) auxiliary for the node-reference array.

optimized.explanation: Use a dummy node before head, walk to the node before left, then repeatedly move the node after the segment head to the front of the segment.
optimized.correctness_idea: Each head insertion places the next unreversed node at the segment's front. After right-left such moves, the segment is reversed and both boundary links still connect to the unchanged prefix and suffix.
optimized.time_complexity: O(n) — locating the segment and performing its reversals takes linear time.

steps.event: Locate segment boundary and first node.
steps.condition: left is 2, so before is at position 1.
steps.action: Keep node 6 as the fixed tail while remaining nodes are moved in front.

steps.event: Move node 9 to the segment front.
steps.condition: One of right-left = 2 front insertions is complete.
steps.action: Detach 9 after 6 and place it after node 2.

steps.event: Move node 4 to the segment front.
steps.action: Detach 4 and place it after node 2.

edge_cases.handling: The insertion loop runs zero times and returns the original ordering.
The dummy node provides the predecessor needed to update the returned head.
The segment tail retains its link to null after the final move.
